title.narrative: Increased capacity of Member States to develop effective and efficient labour market programmes and services to support transitions

description.narrative: The focus of this Global Product is to facilitate knowledge development and dissemination, guidance and capacity development, and evidence-based action to support efficient and effective transitions in a rapidly changing labour market. It will do so by developing a comprehensive and user-oriented set of studies, research, tools and guidelines on labour market programmes, employment-intensive investment and public employment programmes and employment services to facilitate inclusive transitions and the implementation of innovative approaches, including South–South learning, knowledge development and dissemination. It will also expand the Employment Policy Gateway to include a repository of active labour market programmes focusing on developing countries. As a standards-based organization, the ILO will continue to promote in this policy area the ratification and implementation of the Employment Services Convention, 1948 (No.88) and the Private Employment Agencies Convention, 1997 (No.181) under the ongoing global campaign with a view to promoting more efficient and affective functioning of labour markets as they grapple with multiple crises. Moreover, it will strengthen the capacity of public and private national partners in collaboration with the Turin Centre and other organizations through global, regional or national customized capacity development initiatives. To ensure broad outreach and impact, the ILO will strengthen partnerships for more effective and coherent programmes and employment services, including employment-intensive employment programmes, across regions, including through cooperation with global and regional specialised organizations, private sector and UN agencies with a stronger and principal role for social partners on work-related policy matters, as well as with international financial institutions.
